title: 第1037章 新的风暴正在酝酿第1036章 心态爆炸的沈秋
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
一场谈话，就此尘埃落定。
唯余悬棺中那截猩红毛发，成了一个未解的谜题，久久萦绕在众人心头。
“诸位，有缘再会。”
留下这句警示后，沈云并未多做停留。
他大袖一挥，乘风而起，孤身踏上了归程。
全场肃然相送，直到那飒然背影没入云海，才陆陆续续收回目光。
“沈先生金口玉言，定然不会有假，看来这座仙王神墓，确实还未到开启之时。”
上官师兄轻叹一声，神色平静，似乎对此并不上心。
原因很简单，他虽号称秘境之狐，却也明白自己的斤两，仙王的无上传承，岂是他这个半步金仙能觊觎的？
“哼，天无绝人之路，我才不信有什么十死无生的杀局。”
沈兄双臂环胸，傲然道：“小爷是给沈云一个面子，否则这什么仙王大墓，我十天内就能轻松拿下。”
“呃....”
望着他那牛气哄哄的样子，周围众人一阵无言。
若非刚才听到那声‘多谢大哥’，单凭这斩钉截铁的态度，恐怕还真有人信了他的鬼话。
“你还是莫要尝试为好，免得连累了沈道友。”
苍昊沉声开口，一双火眼如镜似渊，死死钉在那诡异红毛之上。
“此物绝非巴蛇老祖所留，而是源自一尊更加恐怖的存在。”
经过沈云的提点，他已发现了其中蹊跷。
在海量精气的滋养下，的确容易滋生恶灵，但不要忘了，这悬棺可是巴蛇老祖的胃囊铸就——别说区区邪物，便是大罗金仙误入，也势必被吞噬溶解，化为乌有。
“怪不得。”

沈秋猛地一拍脑门，恍然大悟：“我就说刚才精气涌现的时候，这鬼东西为何突然疯涨，原来竟是来抢食的。”
“嗯？！”
苍昊双眼微眯，似是从这无心之言中联想到了什么，轻声自语：“看来....的确是一尊了不得的存在，怪不得连沈道友都如此慎重。”
能与巴蛇老祖争夺生机者，岂会是泛泛之辈？一旦踏入对方布下的杀局，只怕还真是十死无生。
“走吧，既然神墓不在此地，久留无益。”
陆晨适时开口，拍了拍衣袍提醒道：“别忘了，功德神战还在进行，我们已经耽搁两日了。”
此言一出，沈秋与上官师兄反响平平。
对这两名秘境专业户而言，试炼排名不过是过眼云烟，唯有寻宝才是头等大事。
至于一旁的苍昊，更是毫无波澜。
大罗战力一出，谁有资格与他争锋？哪怕再耽搁十天半月，他也有信心后来居上。
content_en:
The conversation ended here.
The scarlet hair remaining in the hanging coffin has become an unsolved mystery that has lingered in everyone's minds for a long time.
"Everyone, we'll meet again when we are destined."
After leaving this warning, Shen Yun did not stay much longer.
He waved his sleeves, took off in the wind, and embarked on his return journey alone.
The whole audience watched each other in solemn silence, until the sassy figure disappeared into the sea of ​​clouds, and then one after another they looked away.
"Mr. Shen's golden words are definitely not false. It seems that the tomb of the Immortal King and God has not yet been opened."
Brother Shangguan sighed softly, with a calm expression, as if he was not concerned about this.
The reason is very simple. Although he is known as the Fox of the Secret Realm, he also knows his own weight. How can the supreme inheritance of the Immortal King be coveted by him, a half-step golden immortal?
"Hmph, there is no perfect path, I don't believe there is any such thing as a dead end."
Brother Shen crossed his arms across his chest and said proudly: "Young Master is trying to give Shen Yun some face, otherwise I can easily capture this Immortal King's Tomb within ten days."
"Uh..."
Looking at his arrogant look, everyone around him was speechless for a while.
If he hadn't heard that 'Thank you, brother' just now, based on his decisive attitude, some people might have believed his lies.
"You'd better not try it, so as not to implicate Fellow Daoist Shen."
Cang Hao spoke in a deep voice, his blazing eyes like mirrors and abyss fixed on the strange red hair.
"This object is definitely not left by the ancestor of Ba Snake, but comes from an even more terrifying existence."
After Shen Yun's suggestion, he discovered something fishy.
Under the nourishment of a large amount of essence, it is indeed easy for evil spirits to breed, but don't forget that this hanging coffin was made from the stomach of the Ba She ancestor - not to mention mere evil objects, even if the Daluo Jinxian accidentally entered it, it would be swallowed up, dissolved, and turned into nothing.
"No wonder."
Shen Qiu suddenly slapped his forehead and suddenly realized: "I'm just telling you why this ghost thing suddenly surged when the energy emerged just now. It turns out that it's here to grab food."
"Huh?!"
Cang Hao narrowed his eyes slightly, as if he thought of something from this unintentional remark, and whispered to himself: "It seems...it is indeed an extraordinary existence. No wonder even Fellow Daoist Shen is so cautious."
How can anyone who can compete with the Ba Snake Ancestor for life be an ordinary person? Once you step into the killing situation set by the opponent, you will probably die without any chance of survival.
"Let's go. Since the tomb of God is not here, it will be useless to stay for a long time."
Lu Chen spoke at the right time, patted his robe and reminded: "Don't forget, the battle of merit and virtue is still going on, we have been delayed for two days."
As soon as these words came out, Shen Qiu and Senior Brother Shangguan had a mediocre response.
For these two secret realm professionals, the trial rankings are just a passing moment, and treasure hunting is the top priority.
As for Cang Hao on the side, he was even more unfazed.
Once Da Luo's fighting power comes out, who is qualified to compete with him? Even if it were delayed for another ten days and a half, he was confident of catching up from behind.
